question: Should shared-kit Periphery recovery support independent producer retries, or should the workflow require both producers to rerun together before intersection?
rationale: Both choices change the permanent release-gate recovery contract; the current runner-only change does not establish which behavior maintainers want or make either contract safe.

options.title: Resolve artifacts per producer
options.body: Have `intersect` select each producer’s latest successful report so a retry of only one failed producer can complete without rerunning its successful sibling.

options.title: Retry both producers together
options.body: Define shared-kit recovery as a coordinated rerun and enforce that contract before `intersect` downloads attempt-specific artifacts.

recommendation.title: Resolve artifacts per producer
recommendation.body: Have `intersect` select each producer’s latest successful report so a retry of only one failed producer can complete without rerunning its successful sibling.
